facts.material: plastic helmet with auto-darkening filter and respirator (assumed powered/with replaceable filters)
facts.function: welding face/head protection plus supplied filtered breathing air

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9020 other breathing appliances, excluding protective masks lacking mechanical parts or replaceable filters
GRI 3(b): helmet plus respirator composite; respiratory function assumed essential character (alternatively 6506.10.60)

rejected_alternatives.reason: safety headgear; respirator unit gives the breathing appliance character
that is for parts/accessories; complete unit is an appliance
welding filter is part of helmet, not spectacles

missing_facts: whether respirator is powered (blower) or filter-only
whether helmet and respirator are imported together as a unit
classification.rationale: A welding helmet with integral respirator is a breathing appliance with mechanical parts/replaceable filters under 9020; no in-force ruling found on point.
